title: Krishna Educational Foundation | KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Centres / Startup and Innovation Ecosystem Krishna Educational Foundation (KEF) About KEF Section 8 Incubation Platform Promoted by KPGU Krishna Educational Foundation (KEF), Vadodara, Gujarat is a registered Section 8 company under the Companies Act 2013, promoted by Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. KEF is actively engaged in harnessing the entrepreneurial potential of startups by providing end-to-end support through seed funds, co-working infrastructure, advanced lab access, mentoring, and networking with industry mentors, investors, government stakeholders and entrepreneurs. KEF envisions itself as a collaborative platform that helps transform early-stage startups into sustainable business ventures that deliver strong economic and social impact. Visit KEF Website Incubation Domains Incubator Sectors Adtech Agritech Biotechnology Clean Technology Deep Technology Defence Design and Art Edtech Enterprise Tech FMCG and Supply Chain Management Technology Health and Wellness Healthcare Healthtech HRtech ICT Manufacturing Media and Entertainment Pharmacy and Applied Science Services Social Enterprise Surveillance and Security Toy and Gaming Value Proposition Incubator Key Features Feature 01 A hub to ignite ingenuity, creativity and innovation in the hearts of budding startups where every passing day promises a better tomorrow. Feature 02 A hi-tech incubation centre with co-working space, state-of-the-art infrastructure and lab facilities for assisting startups. Feature 03 Focus on IPR commercialization along with startup incubation. Feature 04 Strong startup-industry interface and functional collaboration for product commercialization. Feature 05 Collaboration with world-class technical and commercialization experts through awareness, training and mentoring programs. Feature 06 Active partnerships with local industry partners, IP consultants, angel investors and venture capital-based financial support. Feature 07 Functional support for product development, business development, policy formation, HR management, marketing, legal and financial compliances, and networking. Feature 08 Post-incubation support through full-scale business planning and corporate-startup strategic engagement. Growth Indicators Key Accomplishments Achievement 01 Grant sanctioned from government agencies: 3 Cr (Startup India - Government of India) + 2 Cr (SSIP - Government of Gujarat). Achievement 02 Nodal Institute of Startup Gujarat Cell (Industries Commissionerate - Government of Gujarat). Achievement 03 2200+ startup applications received for incubation. Achievement 04 36 startups supported financially. Achievement 05 50+ startups incubated. Achievement 06 75+ mentors onboarded. Achievement 07 17.65 Crore revenue generated by startups. Achievement 08 110+ jobs created by startups. Achievement 09 Recognition award for excellent work by Startup Vadodara Community and ICAI. Achievement 10 Ranked among top 5 incubators under Startup India. Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. Approved by UGC, AICTE, PCI & AYUSH.
